Who is behind the OGC Standards?

OGC Standards are developed through a member-driven consensus process, which creates royalty free, publicly available, open geospatial standards. TheOpen Geospatial Consortium (OGC) is the organisation which drives this process. It is supported by an active community of members, with involvement from a large range of organizations, as well as smaller ones.
